related.title: ARCHER2：SMT 兄弟執行緒與實體核心覆蓋
related.titleEn: ARCHER2: SMT sibling placement and physical-core coverage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付工作集帳本、分片移動清單、兩組群負載圖與重複歸屬反例；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-006 --out ./hpc-a-006-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the working-set ledger, fragment-migration list, both domain-load distributions and a duplicate-accounting counterexample. Include a concise explanation of why total free memory alone did not reveal the problem. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-006 --out ./hpc-a-006-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
related.difference: 輸入 logical_cpu、socket、core、thread 欄位；產生每個核心的擁有者清單與未覆蓋核心清單。
related.differenceEn: Read logical_cpu, socket, core and thread columns. Emit a per-core worker list and uncovered-core list, preserving logical identifiers so the audit can be traced back to the allocation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 工作集偏斜定義為最大群負載除以八群平均負載；它是配置不均指標，不是總體效能降低比例；八群工作集為 [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,24] GiB；變更後各群 10 GiB，總量皆為 80 GiB；名義式 24/(80/8) = 2.4 skew ratio；變更式 10/(80/8) = 1 skew ratio。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

將邏輯 CPU 映射到 socket、core 複合鍵，再計算唯一核心數除以目標核心數；不可跨 socket 單獨以 core_id 去重；十六執行緒名義上使用八個核心的兩個 SMT 兄弟；變更為十六個核心各一執行緒，目標均為十六核心；名義式 8/16*100 = 50 %；變更式 16/16*100 = 100 %。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Define skew as maximum domain load divided by the mean over eight domains. This placement metric reveals imbalance but does not directly predict application slowdown or bandwidth loss. Record the synthetic working-set vector [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,24] GiB. Rebalance it to eight entries of 10 GiB while preserving the 80 GiB total and the same collection of logical arrays. Nominal 24/(80/8) = 2.4 skew ratio; changed 10/(80/8) = 1 skew ratio. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Map logical CPUs to composite socket-and-core keys, then divide unique physical cores by the target count. Deduplicating bare core_id values across sockets can incorrectly merge different cores. In the teaching topology, sixteen workers initially occupy two siblings on each of eight cores. The changed assignment occupies one thread on each of sixteen cores. The target is sixteen physical cores in both cases. Nominal 8/16*100 = 50 %; changed 16/16*100 = 100 %. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: KSM：解除合併時的記憶體餘裕
related.titleEn: KSM: memory headroom for unmerging shared pages
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付工作集帳本、分片移動清單、兩組群負載圖與重複歸屬反例；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-006 --out ./hpc-a-006-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the working-set ledger, fragment-migration list, both domain-load distributions and a duplicate-accounting counterexample. Include a concise explanation of why total free memory alone did not reveal the problem. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-006 --out ./hpc-a-006-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
related.difference: 建立 content_id、mapping_id、bytes 表；先依內容去重算已用，再依映射算全部分離後需求。
related.differenceEn: Build a content_id, mapping_id and bytes ledger. Calculate current backing storage by deduplicated content, then calculate fully separated demand by mapping, preserving both totals and their difference.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 工作集偏斜定義為最大群負載除以八群平均負載；它是配置不均指標，不是總體效能降低比例；八群工作集為 [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,24] GiB；變更後各群 10 GiB，總量皆為 80 GiB；名義式 24/(80/8) = 2.4 skew ratio；變更式 10/(80/8) = 1 skew ratio。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

若一份大小 B 的內容由 r 個映射完整共享，全部分離的額外容量為 (r-1)B；忽略頁表、碎片及不完全相同內容；共享內容為 40 GiB；名義有三個映射，變更四個；每份在解除合併後都完整獨立；名義式 (3-1)*40 = 80 GiB additional；變更式 (4-1)*40 = 120 GiB additional。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Define skew as maximum domain load divided by the mean over eight domains. This placement metric reveals imbalance but does not directly predict application slowdown or bandwidth loss. Record the synthetic working-set vector [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,24] GiB. Rebalance it to eight entries of 10 GiB while preserving the 80 GiB total and the same collection of logical arrays. Nominal 24/(80/8) = 2.4 skew ratio; changed 10/(80/8) = 1 skew ratio. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

If r complete mappings share one identical B-sized backing set, fully separating them requires an additional (r-1)B. The model excludes page tables, fragmentation and partially identical content. Use a 40 GiB identical backing set shared by three mappings, then four. Every mapping becomes fully independent after unmerging; the assumption is deliberately stronger than a workload with only a few modified pages. Nominal (3-1)*40 = 80 GiB additional; changed (4-1)*40 = 120 GiB additional. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
